profile.reading: Per Digital Crossroad own site, this Hammond, Indiana facility (on the Illinois and Indiana border) is a 105,000 square foot building known as DX-1, with more than 72,000 square feet of data hall space available to customers. DX-1 is built to Tier III concurrently maintainable standards and supports up to 20 MW of critical load, drawing on a 100 plus MW on site substation for future expansion. The facility is audited to ISO 27001 and SOC 2 standards. No street address is published on this page.
